entries.title: Psalms 116:1
segments: ¶I love the LORD, because He has heard My voice [and] my supplications.

entries.title: Psalms 116:2
segments: Because He has inclined His ear to me, Therefore I will call [upon Him] as long as I live.

entries.title: Psalms 116:3
segments: The pains of death surrounded me, And the pangs of Sheol laid hold of me; I found trouble and sorrow.

entries.title: Psalms 116:4
segments: Then I called upon the name of the LORD: "O LORD, I implore You, deliver my soul!"

entries.title: Psalms 116:5
segments: Gracious [is] the LORD, and righteous; Yes, our God [is] merciful.

entries.title: Psalms 116:6
segments: The LORD preserves the simple; I was brought low, and He saved me.

entries.title: Psalms 116:7
segments: Return to your rest, O my soul, For the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.

entries.title: Psalms 116:8
segments: For You have delivered my soul from death, My eyes from tears, [And] my feet from falling.

entries.title: Psalms 116:9
segments: I will walk before the LORD In the land of the living.

entries.title: Psalms 116:10
segments: ¶I believed, therefore I spoke, "I am greatly afflicted."

entries.title: Psalms 116:11
segments: I said in my haste, "All men [are] liars."

entries.title: Psalms 116:12
segments: What shall I render to the LORD [For] all His benefits toward me?

entries.title: Psalms 116:13
segments: I will take up the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 116:14
segments: I will pay my vows to the LORD Now in the presence of all His people.

entries.title: Psalms 116:15
segments: Precious in the sight of the LORD [Is] the death of His saints.

entries.title: Psalms 116:16
segments: O LORD, truly I [am] Your servant; I [am] Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have loosed my bonds.

entries.title: Psalms 116:17
segments: I will offer to You the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 116:18
segments: I will pay my vows to the LORD Now in the presence of all His people,

entries.title: Psalms 116:19
segments: In the courts of the LORD'S house, In the midst of you, O Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
